author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
Remember this jam? It’s that time of the year again! The MIT 24-Hour Challenge, MIT’s giving day, is here! Today, March 12, 2026, your support of MIT OpenCourseWare (and other free offerings from MIT Open Learning and MITx) ensures we can keep educating the world with MIT’s life-changing, society-advancing educational resources.

Make your gift to MIT OpenCourseWare by 11:59 p.m. EST: giving.mit.edu/24hc-ocw
